original.statement: Traefik's Kubernetes Gateway API provider now supports the RequestHeaderModifier filter.

decision.reason: [ev-53aef8a0056b] lists "Support RequestHeaderModifier filter" (#10521) under v3.0.0 Enhancements, so "added" is the right change type. The k8s/gatewayapi component is copied from the entry's tags, and the kebab-case name uses only the evidence's own words. The webui and middleware tags come from the same single PR, so this is one change, not several bundled together. Choosing protocol-behavior as the family is a judgment call the excerpt doesn't settle, so confidence is low.
